en: In or to which place; or the place in which something happens.
ex: Where do you live?
你住在哪裡？

en: Used to talk about two or more possibilities; or used to say that something is true in either case.
ex: I don't know whether he will come.
我不知道他會不會來。

en: Used to ask about one or more people or things from a limited number; or used to introduce a clause.
ex: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
你比較喜歡哪個，茶還是咖啡？

en: During the time that something is happening; or a short period of time; or although.
ex: She read a book while she waited.
她等的時候看了一本書。

en: The color of snow or milk; or pale; or the part of an egg or eye.
ex: She wore a white dress to the wedding.
她穿了一件白色洋裝去婚禮。

en: Used to ask which person; or used to introduce a clause about a person.
ex: Who is that girl over there?
那邊那個女孩是誰？

en: Used to ask who owns something; or used to show that something belongs to a person.
ex: Whose coat is this?
這是誰的外套？

en: For what reason; or the reason for something.
ex: Why are you late?
你為什麼遲到？

en: Measuring a large distance from side to side; or including many different things; or fully open.
ex: The river is very wide here.
這裡的河面非常寬。

en: To be the best or first in a competition; or to get something by effort; or a victory.
ex: Our team won the match.
我們的隊伍贏得了比賽。

en: An opening in a wall or vehicle, usually filled with glass; or a rectangle on a computer screen.
ex: Please close the window; it's cold.
請把窗戶關上，很冷。

en: Having or showing good judgment and experience.
ex: It was wise of you to save money.
你存錢很明智。

en: To want something to happen; or a desire for something.
ex: I wish you a happy birthday.
祝你生日快樂。

en: Together with someone or something; or using something; or having something.
ex: I live with my parents.
我和父母住在一起。

en: Not having something; or not doing something.
ex: She left without saying goodbye.
她沒有說再見就離開了。

en: An adult female person.
ex: The woman at the desk gave me a map.
櫃檯的那位女士給了我一張地圖。

en: Extremely good; or causing a feeling of great pleasure or surprise.
ex: We had a wonderful holiday in Japan.
我們在日本度過了美好的假期。

en: The planet on which we live; or all the people on it; or a particular area of activity.
ex: She wants to travel around the world.
她想環遊世界。

en: To form letters or words on paper; or to create a book, article or music.
ex: Please write your name at the top of the page.
請把你的名字寫在頁面頂端。

en: A person whose job is writing books, stories or articles.
ex: The writer signed copies of her new book.
作家為她的新書簽名。

en: A period of twelve months; or the age of a person.
ex: I will graduate from school next year.
我明年就要畢業了。

en: The color of lemons or butter; or a color of cowardice.
ex: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
樹葉在秋天變黃。

en: Up to now or then; or in spite of this; or used to emphasize something.
ex: I haven't finished my homework yet.
我還沒寫完作業。

en: Used to refer to the person or people being spoken to.
ex: You are my best friend.
你是我最好的朋友。

en: Not old; having lived or existed for only a short time; or the young animals.
ex: She looks young for her age.
她看起來比實際年齡年輕。

en: The number 0; or a point on a scale from which measurements begin; or nothing at all.
ex: The temperature fell to zero last night.
昨晚氣溫降到零度。

en: A place where wild animals are kept so that people can see them.
ex: The children saw lions and elephants at the zoo.
孩子們在動物園看到了獅子和大象。

en: To experience something difficult; or to use up all of something; or to examine something carefully.
ex: She had to go through a lot to get here.
她為了來到這裡歷經千辛萬苦。

en: To stretch out your hand or arm; or to continue to exist or last.
ex: He held out his hand to greet me.
他伸出手向我問好。

en: To fall asleep, usually for a short time and without intending to.
ex: Grandpa often dozes off in front of the TV.
爺爺常常在電視前打瞌睡。

en: Used to say that something is so obvious that it does not need to be said.
ex: It goes without saying that you must be honest.
誠實是不言而喻的。

en: To do something to replace or balance a loss, lack or mistake.
ex: He bought her flowers to make up for forgetting her birthday.
他買花給她，彌補忘記她生日的事。

en: To go to someone for help or advice; or to face in a particular direction.
ex: When in trouble, she turns to her sister.
遇到麻煩時，她會向姊姊求助。

en: To work at something with a lot of energy and effort.
col: go at it hammer and tongs
ex: The kids went at the cake with great enthusiasm.
孩子們興致勃勃地吃著蛋糕。

en: To keep something at a low level; or to control something and stop it from growing.
ex: Please keep the noise down; the baby is sleeping.
請小聲一點，寶寶在睡覺。

en: To be owned by someone; or to be a member or part of a group or place.
ex: This book belongs to the library.
這本書屬於圖書館。

en: To visit someone's house, usually informally.
ex: Why don't you come over for a coffee?
你何不過來喝杯咖啡？

en: To allow a person or animal to leave a place; or to make a sound; or to tell a secret.
ex: She let out a scream when she saw the mouse.
她看到老鼠時尖叫了一聲。

en: To remove something from a place; or to subtract; or to buy food to eat elsewhere.
ex: The waiter took away our empty plates.
服務生收走了我們的空盤子。

en: To make someone notice something.
ex: The loud noise called everyone's attention.
巨大的噪音引起了所有人的注意。
